label: Casual outfits
description: Everyday outfits built from relaxed garments and practical separates.
notes: Complete everyday looks, including simple dresses and culturally specific daily garments. Smart owns tailored workwear; athletic owns exercise clothes; summer owns beachwear; cold_weather owns outerwear-led looks. Excludes accessories, props, body descriptors, and grooming. Garments never imply descent or body type. Cultural garments are available in any region. Use subject-appropriate pronouns. Picks require writer compatibility with the setting and activity. Palette roles supply garment colors; blue denim and undyed fabric may retain intrinsic colors. Coverage describes garment extent. Historical dyed looks use muted, earthy or monochrome schemes.
